mapper.sql: FROM yk_nmrms_yjjxs_fhjdp_v A LEFT JOIN yk_zx_goods_nctoinca B ON A.goods_id = B.def2 LEFT JOIN nc65_material C ON B.code = C.product_code LEFT JOIN nc65_m4c_stat_year D ON D.wl_code = C.product_code AND D.year = A.year

where.if: AND (C.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.productCode}, '%') OR B.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.productCode}, '%'))
